summary: Verified both deliverables. (1) BI key gating: super_admin sees the editable 'Key · last4' pill (data-testid='bi-ai-configure-key' x1) and the AIKeyModal is reachable; admin-role (test_admin_bi@jollys.com) sees 0 instances of bi-ai-configure-key, bi-ai-add-key-cta, bi-ai-error-add-key and the modal does not open; admin still receives 403 on PUT /api/admin/ai-settings. (2) Labour % by Revenue card: GET /api/admin/daily-sales/summary now returns by_location[loc].labour_hours and labour_cost for every location; with hourly_rate=12.5 seeded on a staff name appearing in daily_sales, the front-end card 'labour-by-location-card' renders on /jkhive/sales-summary ABOVE 'Total Hours by Staff' with horizontal bars, threshold note and an 'Overall X.X%' tag; when no staff have hourly_rate the card is hidden (graceful fallback). All 5 backend regression tests pass. Existing sales/by-location/staff-hours rendering still works.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_settings router uses PUT (not POST) for set_ai_settings — kept lock via get_super_admin Depends; admin -> 403 confirmed.

sales.py: staff name lookup uses .strip().lower() consistently between staff_rate_map and staff_hours iteration — case mismatches will silently produce labour_cost=0. Consider documenting the case-insensitive contract or normalising at ingest time so a 'john' vs 'John' record cannot create dual rows.

by_location[loc] is initialised with labour_hours=0 and labour_cost=0 — so the API shape is stable even when no staff hours are logged (frontend filter `cost > 0` then hides the card). Good defensive coding.
admin-bi/index.jsx correctly AND-gates the modal `open={showAiKeyModal && isSuperAdmin}` so an admin who somehow toggled the state could not see the modal — defence in depth ✓.
Routes.jsx still has the stale `Routes;` stray statement & unused `SuperAdminOnly` wrapper noted in iteration 34. Cosmetic only.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (super_admin gating + admin gating + labour card placement + threshold note + Overall pct + recharts bars + regression on sales trend & by-location all verified)
